difficulty_reason: The author constructs reconstruction in the completed weighted Besov hierarchy from two successive semigroup limits, first sewing coherent model germs at every scale with a dyadic Cauchy estimate and then passing the smoothing scale to zero with a controlled loss of regularity. Existence and norm bounds require compatibility of regularity and integrability exponents and nonsymmetric inhomogeneous kernels; uniqueness is proved using time continuity and the full local injection mechanism between different Banach completions. Those authored constructions and all needed local core are retained; this is above ordinary qualification analysis even though basic weighted Holder/Young inequalities are supplied. The author explicitly relates the claim to existing coherent-germ reconstruction, so no separate novelty claim is made.
